content.description: An interviewer asks a candidate about relevant experience, work examples and expectations. They use questions to gather information and identify the candidate's needs, ask follow-up questions where needed, and close with a clear description of the next contact rather than an unsupported hiring promise.
flow: Establish the focus of the interview conversation.
Ask about relevant experience and a specific example.
Follow up to clarify the candidate's contribution and priorities.
Clarify what is known about the next contact.
variationPoints: Stakeholders involved in the selection conversation.
B1 direct questions versus B2 probing and clarification.
Industry-specific constraints supplied by the later context overlay.
